rationale: PERF GATE — ungameable and genuinely catches a fold regression. The count is gathered via Connection::trace (sqlite.rs:2642), which fires a callback on every SQL statement SQLite actually executes — the impl cannot influence this count by incrementing an internal counter. count_recursive_cte (line 2594) filters only statements containing 'WITH RECURSIVE walk', so only the reachability CTE increments the counter; the sid-lookup, get_node, and neighbors queries do not. The assertion c2==c16 (line 2653) is genuinely discriminating: a per-seed fold would call cte_reach once per seed, producing 2 CTEs for 2 seeds and 16 for 16 seeds — c2==c16 would fail (2 != 16). The current CTE-based override calls cte_reach_multi once regardless of seed count, so both produce 1. The additional bound (1..=3).contains(&c16) catches a Direction::Both case (2 CTEs) and ensures the count is not trivially 0 (empty implementation). Re-run: 1 passed; 0 failed.
